versions.name: Platformer Checkpoint Info
versions.description: Adds useful information about checkpoints in platformer

about:
# Platformer Checkpoint Info

This mod adds useful information to platformer checkpoints.

This information will help you estimate level length, difficulty and your progress!


<cj>**Right in the level you can see**:</c>
- total number of checkpoints in the level,
- index of the current checkpoint,
- level time when checkpoint was reached.

<cy>**In pause menu and level endscreen in a form of map you can see**:</c>
- total time to reach the checkpoint,
- successful attempt time,
- total attempts to reach the checkpoint,
- progress in level.

Shown information can be configured in settings.
changelog:
# 1.0.0
- Labels on checkpoints: can display time and index
- Checkpoint map in pause menu and end screen (can display total time to reach the checkpoint, successful attempt time, checkpoint progress in level)
